name: Jehucal
overview: Jehucal, also known as Jucal, son of Shelemiah, appears in the book of Jeremiah as a royal official involved in critical moments during King Zedekiah's reign. He was sent alongside Zephaniah to seek the prophet Jeremiah's prayers for the nation, indicating his role in seeking divine guidance. However, Jehucal is also mentioned as one of the princes opposing Jeremiah, urging the king to put the prophet to death because they believed Jeremiah's words undermined the morale of the people and soldiers. These passages reveal Jehucal's position within the political and spiritual tensions of Judah during a time of crisis.
